independentEvaluationMeaning: Separate fixed expected labels and runner; not an independent human benchmark. Holdout fixtures are visible in this repository.
limitations: Small samples do not establish population accuracy.
Errors and abstentions are excluded from binary confusion rates; inspect coverage and exact-status accuracy.
Baseline compares to a frozen safe draft, and does not inspect attributes.
No automatic retries or live claim is made by offline results.
